name: person-lookup
description: Read-only public professional lookup for one named person at a known company via one bounded five-result Apollo people-search through the SELAT Router over MPP on Tempo. Requires a full name and current company; it does not request private contact data or send outreach.

name.description: Full professional name of the target person.

company.description: Known current employer or organization, added to the search keywords to disambiguate the person.

steps.label: five-result public professional search — Apollo people-search (MPP on Tempo)
